desc: Your collection is incomplete without a Bright Stainless 1911. The features you love about a Colt Government Model – American forged stainless steel, National Match Barrel – with indisputable style. White 3-dot sights and our famous trigger make shooting a breeze, while double-diamond rosewood grips and high-polish mirror finish make showing off even easier. Available in 45 ACP and .38 Super.
